Identity-carrying elements are the category default for a small civic booking service: pale grey-green ground, white header and footer bands, one dark-green accent on buttons and availability chips, one sans in bold/regular, bordered white cards with 4px radius, native-looking form controls (items-ladder-3m/default/1280-light.png).

The only 'imagery' is the same generic wrench glyph on a pale-green square repeated on all ten tool cards, including the ladder, pressure washer and wallpaper steamer: a placeholder, not a picture of the stock.

Similar-prompt test fails: 'reservation flow for a volunteer-run repair cafe / seed library' would predict the same restrained green, card list, stepper-less form flow and summary-list confirm page.
